channel.title: AI Tool Lab — Paid Automation Offers & Partner Opportunities
channel.description: Public, bounded AI workflow automation offers and zero-upfront, success-fee partner opportunities with structured transaction paths.

item.title: Agency Portfolio License kickoff reservation — ¥49,800 credited to ¥498,000 first-year fee
item.description: After public-scope fit and written terms confirmation, reserve an Agency Portfolio License kickoff slot for ¥49,800. The reservation is credited in full to the ¥498,000 first-year fee, leaving ¥448,200. The annual license covers up to 500 organizations per month, twelve differential CSV updates and up to ten named users in one legal entity. Submitting the public form alone creates no contract or charge.

item.title: Agency Portfolio Pilot — ¥59,800 fixed, fully credited to annual license
item.description: One fixed-scope public-source certification portfolio pilot covering 50 organizations, delivered as a CSV with official domains, certification context, expiry context and evidence URLs. Price is ¥59,800. If the buyer upgrades to the ¥498,000 annual Agency Portfolio License within 30 days after pilot delivery, the full ¥59,800 is credited to the first-year fee. Scope, contract and payment terms are confirmed in writing before work begins.

item.title: Certification Renewal Radar — ¥198,000/year prepaid
item.description: Twelve monthly public-source certification-signal updates covering up to 100 companies per month. Annual prepayment is ¥198,000, a ¥39,600 discount versus twelve ¥19,800 monthly payments. The linked form records plan interest only; scope, contract and payment terms are confirmed in writing before work begins.

item.title: Referral Partner — earn up to ¥98,000 per eligible annual Team Pack contract
item.description: Zero registration fee and zero advertising spend required. Earn ¥98,000 after an eligible referred buyer prepays ¥980,000 for the 12-month Automation Team Pack. Pre-registration, attribution, cleared payment and no cancellation or refund are required. No unsolicited email or direct messages.

item.title: AI Workflow Automation Pilot — ¥49,000 fixed
item.description: One bounded repetitive workflow, one measurable acceptance criterion and one correction pass. A fitted slot may be reserved for ¥9,800 after written fit confirmation; it is fully credited to the ¥49,000 total.

item.title: Automation Team Pack — ¥98,000/month or ¥980,000/year prepaid
item.description: Bounded recurring delivery for up to five active workflows. Choose ¥98,000 monthly or ¥980,000 prepaid for 12 months, a ¥196,000 discount versus 12 monthly payments. Monthly scope limits, billing, renewal, cancellation and refund terms are confirmed in writing before payment.
